definitions.explanation: The ability to understand something without conscious reasoning.
A natural sense or perception beyond the five senses.

notes:
{勘|かん} refers to intuitive understanding.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {勘|かん}がいい: to have good intuition
- {勘|かん}が{悪|わる}い: to have poor intuition
- {勘|かん}が{働|はたら}く: intuition works
- {勘|かん}を{頼|たよ}りに: relying on intuition

COMPOUNDS:
- {勘違|かんちが}い: misunderstanding
- {勘定|かんじょう}: calculation, bill
